_comment: Packages installed for development that the desktop package does not redistribute. Bundling inlines JavaScript, so a package whose only payload is a native binary ships nothing unless staging copies it explicitly (stage-managed-backend.ts does that for bun-pty's rust_pty.dll and Photon's wasm; Bun.build emits resvg's .node). Listing one of these as shipped would claim a redistribution that never happens — which for the Anthropic entry would be a materially false statement about a proprietary binary. Verify a claim here against a staged tree before trusting it, and never add an entry to make the generator quieter.

@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-win32-x64.reason: Contains only claude.exe (322 MB), the Claude Code binary. The claude-code provider passes pathToClaudeCodeExecutable: CLAUDE_PATH (providers/claude-code.ts), which resolves the user's own Claude Code install from PATH, so this copy is never referenced, staged, or run.
@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-win32-x64.evidence: The staged package is ~30 MiB and contains no file matching *claude*; its only native artifacts are photon_rs_bg.wasm, resvgjs.win32-x64-msvc-*.node, and rust-pty/target/release/rust_pty.dll.

@lydell/node-pty-win32-x64@1.1.0.reason: Native ConPTY addons (conpty.node, conpty_console_list.node) for @lydell/node-pty. Staging copies bun-pty's rust_pty.dll for the terminal; these are not copied.
@lydell/node-pty-win32-x64@1.1.0.evidence: No conpty.node in the staged tree.

@mariozechner/clipboard-win32-x64-msvc@0.reason: Native clipboard addon (clipboard.win32-x64-msvc.node) reached through the pi packages. Staging does not copy it.
@mariozechner/clipboard-win32-x64-msvc@0.evidence: No clipboard.win32-x64-msvc.node in the staged tree.
